details: First section of the MORE SUSHI mobile home types its original branding and hero text slowly after a skippable intro. The cloud status, statistics, home cards, and all other categories only fade/slide in sequentially; their labels are never typed. Returning to home does not replay typewriter. Single Pearl Rose visual theme and original photos, buttons, navigation, cloud, PDF and TTK functionality unchanged. Motion-only code, respects reduced-motion except explicit user replay. Signed native Android APK is not rebuilt.
